Based on the previous round's exploration, I need to calculate the percentage of female patients (among those over 55 with abnormal PT) out of all patients over 55 with abnormal PT.

The evidence specifies: percentage = SUM(PT >= 14 AND SEX = 'F') / SUM(PT >= 14) × 100

FINAL: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.PT >= 14 AND p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN l.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) as percentage FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE (2026 - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 55 AND l.PT IS NOT NULL
